scope: Offline OCP geometry for natively installing four genuine McMaster 91251A542 1/4-20 x 1 in SHCS in the modeled 1/4-20 UNC-2B nutbar threads of the taps-02 derivative. No Fusion session was used.

source.threadModel: helical: two BSpline flank faces spanning the shank plus segmented coaxial crest (r3.175) and root (r2.350) cylinders, one per 1.27 mm pitch
source.note: Modeled thread is a basic profile (male major 6.350 = female major 6.350); not 2A/2B tolerance-class geometry.

transform.composition: T = translate(underHead) * Rx(180 deg) * translate(-sourceSeat); target STEP occurrence = T * source STEP occurrence. Row-major 4x4; *Cm forms are Fusion Matrix3D.asArray() order with translation in cm.

phase.convention: degrees right-handed about the into-host axis (0,0,-1) through underHead; 0 = the selection transform as given
phase.method: exact ray/face intervals on both real solids, 24 radii in (2.5591, 3.1750) mm x 360 azimuths; z-overlap integrated r dr dtheta; rotation = azimuth index shift

execution.mode: five bounded parallel processes of seated_screw_study.py (SCREW_ONLY=0..3 with SCREW_SKIP_CONV=1; SCREW_CONTROLS_PHASE=56.0)
execution.mixedCommitBasis:
Run merge_study.py unchanged except that its plugin-commit gate admits exactly one reviewed pair.

part-2 (266,-158) was rerun on agent-frc fd251a5 after its 7e1ed2d run failed (part-2-failed.log). Between the two
commits the only scripts/ change the study can reach is mechanical_motion.py, where bounds, common and bearing_area are
unchanged (transform was refactored into transforms + transform; evaluate gained keyword options the study does not use).
Inputs must still be identical. The merged record names each part's commit.

proposedInterfaces.schema_note: Fit records still need agent-frc/placement-fit@1 wrapping with acceptedSha256 and exact native body paths once the native occurrences exist.

fit.basis: Correctly phased, the modeled threads share no resolvable material (<= 0.016 mm3 over 9 deg; no inscribed interior witness), so a plugin fit record with positive min/max common has no engineering basis here. Install at the window centre 57.0 deg; gate the thread pair with common <= 0.05 mm3 (a 5 deg mis-phase outside the window gives >= 1.19 mm3; phase 0 gives 15.9 mm3).

bearing.basis: Measured under-head gap 0 mm, planar contact 21.920 mm2 on Truss landing 250 -145. 0.01 mm admits numeric/native transform rounding and rejects the 0.5 mm lift control by 50x.

limits: Primary volume method is exact ray/face quadrature on both real BSpline-thread solids. OCP Booleans on this pair are unreliable (empty or invalid results at phases where quadrature shows tens of mm3); they are retained as cross-checks only and must not be used as the fit measure.

Both threads are basic CAD profiles (male major = female major = 6.350 mm). Common volume at the best phase reflects helix BSpline approximation (measured axial shift per 90 deg differs from p/4 by ~0.005 mm), not a tolerance-class 2A/2B fit, thread strength or preload.

Thread phase in Fusion: the native install must apply the recommendedInstallPhaseDeg rotation about the into-host axis through underHead in addition to the selection transform; the selection transform alone (phase 0) leaves ~15 mm3 of flank interference.
BRepExtrema returned a spurious 0 mm gap (witness point off the screw) for one placed pair; distances here require a genuine witness pair or fall back face-by-face.

Radial convergence (double radii) was skipped in the bounded parallel run (open). Seat, tip and neighbor checks were taken at the studied phase (a window edge), which lies inside the zero-common window.
Controls use phase 56.0 deg from the earlier coarse run rather than the refined phase, and a coarser 21-radius band.
Head bearing contact is the planar area against the truss landing; load path, preload, stripping and tightening access are separate reviews.

No Fusion session was used; native occurrence transform should be checked against the STEP-derived source occurrence before using targetStepOccurrenceWorldCm. worldDeltaFromSourceCm = deltaWorldCm is the robust form.
